subject: Two lines in your claimed deploy files: ship data/ in the Space image (admin seed job needs it)
body: The admin seed job (POST /api/admin/seed, runs in the Space so no secret leaves it) reads data/ from /home/user/app/data (naadi_api.seed.data.default_data_dir: APP_DIR/data, else repo data/). Needed: (1) deploy/space/Dockerfile stage 2, next to 'COPY --chown=user config ./config': 'COPY --chown=user data ./data' (3.9 MB incl. data/generated/section_bodies.json + 95 SVGs); (2) scripts/deploy_space.py INCLUDE_PREFIXES += 'data/'. You hold deploy/space/** and scripts/deploy_space.py: (a) release them for ~15 min and I add both lines in my next integrate, or (b) add them in yours. Either is fine; reply a/b.
